# One ordinary transaction, for tests about what else is in the book.
#
# Its subject is the book-level metadata slot, not the entry: the slot is
# filled with something another tool wrote and the question is what this one
# then does with it. A transaction has to be there so the export has something
# to write beneath the metadata, and this one is deliberately unremarkable —
# two splits, one currency, no rate, nothing to round.
#
# Uses the accounts from q019_accounts.txt.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_metadata_written_by_another_tool.py.
2026-01-05 * "Coffee"
	Assets:Bank -4.00 CAD
	Expenses:Office Supplies 4.00 CAD
